# contraco

> Premium transformation consulting. Founded 1998 by Frank Meltke. Global hub at contraco.com.

contraco.com is the global hub and brand anchor for contraco. Content is available in English, German, Russian, and Korean.

- [English](https://contraco.net)
- [German](https://contraco.de)
- [Russian](https://contraco.ru)
- [Korean](https://contraco.co.kr)
